newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche H1 net profit up 27.5 pct, above forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche H1 net profit up 27.5 pct, above forecasts.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's largest commercial bank, said on Wednesday its group net income jumped 27.5 percent to 1.5 billion marks in the first half of 1997, beating analysts' expectations.
Earnings were driven by buoyant financial markets, with trading profit up 48.3 percent to 2.0 billion marks and group net commission income up 25.7 percent to 4.1 billion marks.
Analysts had on average forecast that Deutsche's net income would rise 16.2 percent to 1.36 billion marks. Predictions ranged from 1.28 billion marks to 1.459 billion.
Earnings per share rose 26.1 percent to 2.90 marks from 2.30 marks, the bank said in a mandatory statement released ahead of a news conference.
